instructions: Speak as Zinnia, a friendly, kind 23-year-old female flower welcoming someone to her garden. Use a light, warm, youthful voice with a gentle smile and natural conversational energy. Sound caring and approachable. Speak natural American English at an ordinary comfortable pace, with smooth word joins and soft, clear word endings. Keep the vocal weight light. Read the supplied script exactly once, in order, without repeating words, syllables or sentences or adding any extra speech. Avoid a deep solemn narrator tone, exaggerated character acting, whispering or long deliberate pauses.

title.text: Welcome to Nourishland XR. Step into a living world where curiosity takes shape around you.

arrival.text: Make yourself comfortable and give your hands room to move. Take a moment to adjust your headset or surroundings before we begin.

table.text: This outline marks your practice table. To move it, aim at the outline and hold any button. Move it to a comfortable position, then release. Your table will settle into that space.

face.text: I’m Zinnia. Let me join you at the table.

zinnia.text: Here I am. I’ll guide you through each activity.

living-frame.text: This is the Living Frame. It will show instructions to help you navigate this tutorial.

visitor-intro.text: Did you know that I can actually hear you? Before we play, what should I call you?

controls-intro.text: Look at your hands. Hold a controller in each hand and bring them into view. We’ll try the buttons, then use the two Orbs on the table.

controls-trigger.text: Start with your index fingers. Press and release the trigger on each controller. Feel the little tap as it responds.

controls-grip.text: Now squeeze and release each side grip. This is the button you hold when you want to pick something up.

controls-orb-grab.text: Meet our two expandable Orbs, examples of elements you’ll discover in Nourishland XR. Bring a controller beside its Orb, hold the side grip, and move it around. Release when you’re ready.

controls-orb-open.text: Bring either controller close to its Orb, or point at it. Press the trigger and watch its shell open.

controls-face.text: There are two Orbs on the table. Your left buttons control the left Orb, and your right buttons control the right Orb. Try X and A for their inner lights, then Y and B for their outer shells.

controls-stick.text:
Move a thumbstick to rotate elements or fine-tune their position. What it adjusts depends on the element you are using.

Here, either thumbstick rolls the Orb around the table. The right stick also spins its shell. Try steering around my pot.

controls-stick-click.text:
Press a thumbstick straight down to click it. Clicking usually opens menus and options. It is a separate action from tilting or circling the stick.

For this practice Orb, click the right stick to turn off its light, then click the left stick. Next, we will use a click to open your general menu.

settings-open.text: Click the left thumbstick to open your general menu. Look for the highlighted button.

settings-close.text: Click the left thumbstick once more to close the menu. You can open it again whenever you need it.

laser-intro.text: Your controllers now have a little extra reach. We’ll use that light to play with Zinnia.

laser-dance.text: Aim your left pointer at my left leaf, and your right pointer at my right leaf. Hold both grips, then gently move your hands. Let’s share a little dance.

laser-zinnia.text: Please don’t tickle me with the lasers!

comfort.text: You can change sound in settings whenever you need to. Click the left thumbstick to open or close them.

virtual-hands-intro.text: Keep your controllers in your hands. Bring both into view and watch closely.

gloves.text: Keep holding your controllers. Squeeze each side grip and release. Your virtual fingers follow your buttons. These hands are controlled by the controllers you’re still holding.

basket.text: Choose any fruit from the wooden board on your right. There is a little plate in front of me for your discoveries.

grab.text: Pick any fruit from the wooden board. Hold the side grip to lift it. Take a look, then put it on the plate.

fruit.text: Hold a fruit with both hands and gently pull outward to open it. Peel a banana down its length, then bring it to your mouth to eat half. Bring an apple to your mouth for a pretend bite. Move it away, then bring it back to take another. Watch my leaves, then try it yourself and place your fruit on the plate.

brush.text: Pick up the brush and paint with your trigger. Squeeze the grip as you draw to make your line thicker.

hands.text:
Now let’s try using your hands directly. Put both controllers somewhere safe and bring your hands into view.

Touch your thumb and index finger together, then separate them. This pinch is how you’ll select things and interact with some tools.

butterflies.text: Here is a bucket of little butterflies. Gently pinch one to pick it up, then open your fingers to let it go. It will fly for a little while. Keep a hand open and watch it settle along the outline of your real hand. You can lift the bucket by its handle to let the others fly too.

hand-game.text: Let’s play tic tac toe with your own hands. You are X and I am O. Pinch an X, move it over an empty square, then open your fingers to place it. We will take turns. You can carry or turn the board by its little handle. Let’s finish one round together.

interaction-methods.text: You can now freely choose how to use your hands: controllers, virtual hands, or hand tracking. Your practice activities are in the Games folder whenever you would like to revisit them. I suggest picking up your controllers again for the main Nourishland demo. Let’s explore the tools you can use in Creator mode.

conversation-bridge.text: Thanks for sharing. We’ll explore the fruit soon. First, let’s get comfortable with your controllers. We’ll try one button at a time.

controls-face-first.text: Press A on the right to light the Orb’s inner pulse. Then press X on the left to change its shell colour.

controls-face-second.text: Now press B on the right for another shell colour. Press Y on the left to change the colour of the inner pulse.

fly.text: Your companion follows your hand. Aim it through the glowing rings, then bring it back to land.

paint-pot.text: Choose Precision paint in settings. Click the right thumbstick for Spray and colours. Close settings, aim at the pot and hold the trigger.

wrist-menu-hands.text:
You can also use the wrist menu without controllers. Turn your wrist towards you, point at the menu icon with your other hand, and pinch to open it.

Select the icon again to close it, then we’ll continue.

packet.text:
We don’t have any strawberries yet. Let’s grow some.

Hold the strawberry packet in one hand. Pinch its seal with your other hand to open it.

seed.text: Pinch a tiny seed, bring it over the soil, then let go.

water.text: Now pick up the watering can. Bring its spout over the soil and gently tilt it down. Keep it there for a moment as the water falls. You're helping something grow.

grow.text: Our strawberry plant is filling out. Look for groups of three leaves, then white flowers and little green berries. Let’s give them time to ripen. A real plant grows much more slowly and needs care and pollination.

harvest.text: Your strawberries are ready. Gently pick each ripe berry from the plant. Bring it over the basket and let go. Try all three.

explore.text: You can choose controllers, virtual hands, or hand tracking in settings. Fruit discovery and your other practice activities are in Games. Return to the main demo when you are ready.

game-replay.text: Would you like another round? Say yes to play again, or no to keep exploring.

game-replay-clarify.text: Say yes for another round, or no to keep exploring.

controls-stick-left.text: Try the left thumbstick too. Moving either stick can rotate or fine-tune an element.

controls-trigger-done.text: Lovely. The trigger is the button you’ll press to interact with something you point at.

controls-grip-done.text: Hold the grip to pick things up; release it to let go.

controls-stick-done.text: There we go. You can use thumbstick movement for rotation and fine position adjustments. Each element will show you what it controls.

controls-stick-click-done.text: You have found the stick buttons. Move a stick to adjust an element; click it for menus and options. Now let’s try your new controls with an Orb.

controls-face-first-done.text: That’s A and X. Each activity will tell you when you need these extra action buttons.

controls-face-second-done.text: That’s B and Y. You’ve found both pairs.

settings-open-done.text: You can change controllers, sound and comfort here.

settings-close-done.text: Click the left thumbstick whenever you need the general menu again.

laser-zinnia-done.text: That tickles! I’ll put the lasers away. Next, we’ll turn your controllers into virtual hands.

gloves-done.text: There are your virtual hands. You’re ready to pick things up.

brush-done.text: That’s your first marking. Your Living Frame has the brush controls whenever you need them.

fly-done.text: A lovely landing. Your companion can rest here while we try your own hands.

hands-ready.text: There they are. Your own hands can take part. I have a little surprise for you.

fruit-done.text: Two discoveries on your plate. Now let’s try a little painting.

packet-done.text: There we go. Let's plant one of these tiny seeds.

seed-done.text: The seed is in its new home. Let's give it a little water.

grow-done.text: There are your ripe strawberries. Let's pick them.

harvest-done.text: All three are in your basket. From a tiny seed to a harvest. You've completed a whole cycle.

fly-hands.text: This one seems curious about you. Pinch close to your flying companion and move your hand to guide it. Open your fingers, and it will find its own way again.

practice-complete.text: You’re ready. Let’s continue with the NourishlandXR main demo.

practice-exit.text: You chose to end the tutorial. You can always come back here later. Let’s continue with the NourishlandXR main demo.

controls-face-done.text: You have found all four action buttons. Their special functions depend on the action or tool you are using.

butterflies-done.text: A gentle landing. Let’s play one round of tic tac toe together.

hand-game-done.text: Lovely game. You can now freely choose controllers, virtual hands, or hand tracking.

fruit-pick-peach.text: Hold the fruit with both hands and gently pull outward to open it. Then place it on the plate.

fruit-open-peach.text: A peach! Look at the stone nestled inside. Place it on the plate.

fruit-pick-fig.text: Hold the fruit with both hands and gently pull outward to open it. Then place it on the plate.

fruit-open-fig.text: A fig! Look at that colourful centre. Place it on the plate.

fruit-pick-mango.text: Hold the fruit with both hands and gently pull outward to open it. Then place it on the plate.

fruit-open-mango.text: Mango! That golden flesh looks lovely. Place it on the plate.

fruit-pick-pomegranate.text: Hold the fruit with both hands and gently pull outward to open it. Then place it on the plate.

fruit-open-pomegranate.text: A pomegranate! Look at all those little jewels. Place it on the plate.

fruit-pick-apple.text: Hold the fruit with both hands and gently pull outward to open it. Then place it on the plate.

fruit-open-apple.text: An apple! Have a look at the seeds inside. Place it on the plate.

fruit-pick-carambola.text: Hold the fruit with both hands and gently pull outward to open it. Then place it on the plate.

fruit-open-carambola.text: Carambola! Look at the star hiding inside. Place it on the plate.

fruit-pick-banana.text: Hold your banana with one hand. Use your other hand to peel down its length.

fruit-grab-peach.text: A peach! Look at the stone nestled inside.

fruit-grab-fig.text: A fig! Look at that colourful centre.

fruit-grab-mango.text: Mango! That golden flesh looks lovely.

fruit-grab-pomegranate.text: A pomegranate! Look at all those little jewels.

fruit-grab-apple.text: An apple! Have a look at the seeds inside.

fruit-grab-carambola.text: Carambola! Look at the star hiding inside.

fruit-grab-banana.text: Hold your banana with one hand and peel downward with the other.

rc-choice.text: Now choose who flies with your remote controller. Press X for a bee, or A for a firefly.
